You will receive direct training and guidance in: * The standards and expectations involved in delivering professional painting and decorating contracts. * Site measurement, quantity assessment and verification of completed works. * Quality assurance, defect identification and snagging. * Managing communication between subcontractors, site teams and company management. * Understanding the commercial and operational factors that influence contract performance. * Coordinating multiple projects and developing sound professional judgement. Position details **Location:** Dublin and surrounding counties, with travel between project sites. **Contract:** Initial six-month fixed-term contract. **Salary:** Competitive, based on qualifications and suitability. **Working arrangement:** Full-time, site-based and mobile, with administrative and reporting duties as required. **Potential progression:** The position is intended to provide a foundation for further development within the business, subject to performance and future requirements. * **How to apply** If you have recently graduated in a relevant construction discipline and are looking for a practical, challenging opportunity to develop your project management skills, we would like to hear from you. Pay: Up to €34,000.00 per year Benefits: * Bike to work scheme * Company pension Work Location: On the road

title: Sales Executive, Ireland (Remote & Field-Based)
description: CameraMatics helps fleets run safer and smarter. We’re on a mission to transform how fleets operate, using cutting-edge camera technology, AI, machine learning and telematics to make roads safer and businesses smarter. When a driver gets home safely, or a fleet manager spends less time buried in paperwork, that’s the difference our technology can make. We’re a fast growing international SaaS business, and we’re looking for someone who wants to help us grow across Ireland while building a sales career of their own. The role As a Sales Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to build a career from the ground up. You don’t need years of sales experience, an established network or a book of contacts. You do need curiosity, determination and the ambition to become very good at sales. This is an opportunity to learn by doing, with coaching from experienced salespeople, time alongside our leadership team and involvement in real customer opportunities. You’ll learn how to open conversations, understand customer challenges, build relationships and close deals. This is a hands-on role - You’ll spend time speaking with fleet operators and visiting the depots, yards and sites where our customers work. You’ll build your own pipeline, take ownership of your results and learn from the deals you win and the ones you don’t. This is a primarily remote role based in the Republic of Ireland, with travel to customer sites and Cameramatics offices as required. What you’ll do Find and open conversations with fleet operators who don’t know us yet. Build your own sales pipeline and develop relationships with prospective customers. Get out on site and meet the people who run depots, yards and fleets. Learn our products well enough to recognise customer challenges and explain how we can help. Work alongside experienced salespeople and leadership team members on live opportunities, developing the skills to progress and close deals. Use Salesforce and AI tools to research prospects, prepare for meetings and manage your pipeline. Take ownership of your activity, targets and results, using coaching and feedback to improve. What we’re looking for A genuine interest in building a career in sales, with the motivation to put what you learn into practice. Confidence talking to different people, from a depot manager to a managing director, and a willingness to listen. Resilience: you can hear "no", learn from it and come back with a better approach. Curiosity about how businesses work and the problems customers need to solve. The ability to organise your time, follow through on commitments and ask for help when you need it. Comfort using technology and a willingness to learn new systems and tools. A full clean driving licence. A keen interest in business operations, cars and commercial fleets. Experience using a CRM such as Salesforce or HubSpot, or AI tools for research, organisation or productivity. Experience in retail, hospitality, customer service, sales or another customer-facing role. Experience of running a side business, selling something online or taking on a challenging project. These are useful starting points, not prerequisites. We’re interested in what you’ve learned and how you approach things. You don’t need a traditional sales background or a specific degree. What matters is your attitude, curiosity, resilience and willingness to improve. **Real Training On Real Deals** Learn through live customer opportunities, with practical coaching and feedback from experienced sales professionals. **Time With Leadership** Shadow senior team members in customer meetings and see how larger opportunities develop and decisions get made. **Career Progression** Build your skills, take on more responsibility and grow within the business as you demonstrate your ability. **Modern Tools** Use Salesforce and AI to prepare well, reduce admin and spend more time talking to customers. **Visibility** In a growing business, your contribution is visible and good work gets noticed. **Meaningful Impact** Help the businesses that keep the country moving improve safety and operate more efficiently.

title: Support Worker
description: Additional information: We are currently recruiting for two exciting opportunities within our service: Full-Time Support Worker 39 hours per week Relief Support Worker Flexible hours to suit service needs Rates of pay range from €15.03 to €22.19 per hour Whether you're looking for the stability of a full-time role or the flexibility of relief work, we'd love to hear from you. During the next stage of the recruitment process, we'll ask you to confirm which position you would like to be considered for Support work is an impactful job. It's the reason people get to live life their way. Join Positive Futures as a Support Worker and help people with a learning disability, acquired brain injury or autism to live independently, and to have real choice and control over their own lives. You don't need formal qualifications or experience for this role, just kindness, patience, and a sense of fun. You'll get to know the person you're supporting properly: their goals, their routines, what independence looks like for them. From there, you'll support them with everything from daily living skills and personal care, to getting out into their community, keeping in touch with the people who matter to them, and speaking up for themselves. A proper start: Receive a full, paid induction before you're expected to hit the ground running, and join a dedicated team who'll support you every step of the way. Genuine independence, genuine impact: Help people manage their homes, their finances, their health and their social lives, all in a way that puts their choices first. No experience required, just the right qualities: If you're kind, patient, and reliable, we'll teach you the rest!! If you're looking for work that means something, makes a real difference to people, every day, and you've got the patience and values this role needs, we'd love to hear from you. About The Role Every day looks a little different, because every person you support is different too. As a Support Worker, you'll form a positive relationship with the person you support, always maintaining appropriate professional boundaries with them and their families. You'll help them look after their home, manage their money and medication as independently as possible, and get the right support from other services when they need it, whether that's a GP, a social worker, or an advocate. You'll support people to stay safe and healthy in every part of their life, including personal care where it's needed, always treating people with dignity and respect. You'll help them get out into their community, stay connected to the people who matter to them, and speak up for themselves, seeking advocacy support where it's needed rather than deciding things for them. You'll also act as a role model for other staff and volunteers, sharing what you learn and helping new colleagues find their feet. Accurate record keeping (incidents, risk assessments, communication logs) is part of the job too, using our usual digital systems. If you can bring warmth, reliability and genuine respect for people's right to choose their own life, this is a role where that really counts. Required Criteria Minimum 6 months experience providing paid or voluntary care or support for someone. Full, valid IRL/UK/EU/EEA driving licence or an ability to travel independently to meet the requirements of the post. title: Veterinary Nurse
description: **Kilcoole Vets, Co. Wicklow** **Full-time or Part-time, Permanent** **Salary €33,000 to €44,000 DOE** **Build Your Nursing Career in a Practice Where You'll Be Supported to Grow** Kilcoole Vets is excited to welcome applications from Veterinary Nurses at all stages of their career who are looking to develop their skills, pursue their interests and become part of a friendly and supportive team. Whether you're a newly qualified nurse keen to build confidence, an experienced RVN looking for a fresh challenge, or somewhere in between, this is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive small animal practice where professional development and high-quality patient care go hand in hand. You'll work alongside an experienced team of veterinary surgeons, nurses and support staff who genuinely enjoy supporting one another. We are passionate about creating an environment where nurses can grow, develop their clinical interests and feel valued for the important role they play within the practice. We're looking for a confident, proactive and enthusiastic Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working collaboratively and takes pride in delivering excellent care to both patients and clients. If you enjoy a varied caseload, value teamwork and are looking for a practice where your contribution will be recognised, we'd love to hear from you. **A Varied Role with Plenty of Clinical Exposure** This is a hands-on nursing position offering excellent clinical experience across a broad range of nursing duties. A significant part of the role involves anaesthesia monitoring and surgical preparation, giving you the opportunity to build confidence in theatre and develop your anaesthesia skills under the guidance of an experienced team. You'll also be involved in inpatient nursing care, nurse consultations, medication management, patient discharges, post-operative follow-up calls and maintaining high standards of cleanliness and infection control throughout the practice. As part of our collaborative approach, all team members support one another where needed, so there may also be opportunities to assist with reception duties, cattery responsibilities and day-to-day practice operations. No two days are ever quite the same, making this a rewarding position for someone who enjoys variety and being involved in all aspects of practice life. **A Supportive and Friendly Team** At Kilcoole Vets, we believe great patient care starts with a great team environment. We are a close-knit practice consisting of three Veterinary Surgeons, two Veterinary Nurses and three dedicated support team members. Everyone works together to create a welcoming and supportive atmosphere where people feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas and developing their skills. Our team prides itself on maintaining a healthy work-life balance and supporting one another during busy periods. We genuinely value every member of the practice and recognise the important role our nurses play in delivering excellent clinical care. You'll be working alongside experienced clinicians, including a Veterinary Surgeon holding a certificate in surgery and another currently undertaking a certificate in medicine, providing excellent opportunities to learn and develop your own clinical interests. **Modern Facilities and High Standards of Care** Kilcoole Vets is a progressive, 100% small animal practice located in the heart of the beautiful seaside village of Kilcoole. We are proud to be a Silver Accredited Cat Friendly Clinic and place a strong emphasis on providing calm, fear-free experiences for our patients wherever possible. Our purpose-built practice includes a dedicated surgical suite, preparation area, separate dog and cat wards, onsite cattery and comfortable staff facilities, including a team lounge upstairs. Our facilities include digital radiography, dental radiography, ultrasound, therapeutic laser, in-house haematology and biochemistry analysers, microscopy and multiparameter anaesthetic monitoring equipment, allowing us to provide a high standard of care across all areas of the practice. We are particularly proud of the strong relationships we have built with our clients and our reputation for delivering personalised, compassionate veterinary care. **Flexibility and Work-Life Balance** We understand that flexibility looks different for everyone and are happy to consider both full-time and part-time applications. The full-time role is based on 40 hours per week, with working patterns tailored around the needs of both the successful candidate and the practice. This may be worked across four or five days, with shifts scheduled between our opening hours of 8am and 7pm. For candidates seeking part-time hours, we'd be pleased to discuss a working pattern that suits your circumstances. While weekend participation remains important, we are very open to conversations around flexibility and finding an arrangement that works for everyone. The role includes a shared 1 in 3 Saturday rota from 9am to 2pm. There are no out-of-hours commitments and no routine Sunday working. On very rare occasions, assistance may be required for the care of a cattery patient outside normal hours, for example administering medication to an inpatient cat. Any such cover would be recognised with time off in lieu. **What We're Looking For** We're seeking a VCI Registered Veterinary Nurse, or a student nurse eligible for registration in 2026, who is looking to build a rewarding career within a supportive first-opinion practice. For those earlier in their career, you'll benefit from hands-on learning opportunities, mentorship and support from an experienced team. For more experienced nurses, this role offers the opportunity to fully utilise your skills, contribute to practice life, and continue developing your own clinical interests. The ideal candidate will be confident with animal handling, committed to delivering excellent inpatient care, and keen to play an active role in all aspects of nursing within the practice. Strong communication skills, a positive attitude and a team-focused approach are just as important as clinical ability. Above all, we're seeking someone who shares our commitment to kindness, teamwork and exceptional patient care. **Living and Working in Kilcoole** Located on the stunning Wicklow coastline, Kilcoole offers the perfect balance of village charm and accessibility. With beautiful beaches, coastal walks and the Wicklow Mountains nearby, it is an ideal location for anyone seeking an excellent quality of life. The practice is conveniently located within walking distance of local amenities, bus routes and DART services, making commuting straightforward from both Wicklow and Dublin. Ample onsite parking is also available for staff. **What We Offer** In addition to a competitive salary of €33,000 - €44,000 DOE, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, professional development and long-term career growth. We are passionate about investing in our people and providing opportunities to help our nurses thrive throughout their careers. Whether you're taking your first steps as an RVN or bringing years of experience to the team, you'll have access to learning, mentoring and development opportunities to help you achieve your goals. **Benefits (subject to pro-rata)** **Work life balance** * Minimum of 22 days annual leave * Birthday leave **Focus on employee wellbeing** * Paid Maternity, Paternity and Adoptive leave packages * Cycle to work scheme * EAP and wellbeing centre access * Paid bereavement leave * Company sick pay **Development** * €600 annual CPD allowance with 3 days paid (pro-rata) * Bespoke Graduate Nurse Academy, Nurse Evolve and many more in-house academies * Leadership Academy for all future leaders, including Head Nurses and Practice Managers * Career progression opportunities **Professional memberships** * VCI membership paid * VDS cover paid **Additional Benefits** * Annual pay reviews * Pawesome benefits – various discounts including retails and virtual gym * Employee pension contributions * Discounted staff pet veterinary fees * Free flu jabs * Opportunity to join company programmes (LGBTQIA+, Wellbeing Champions, Clinical Board and many more) **Join Our Team** Whether you're looking for your first RVN role, your next challenge, or a practice where you can continue developing an established nursing career, Kilcoole Vets offers the support, flexibility and clinical exposure to help you succeed. Join a welcoming team, develop your skills within a progressive practice, and build a rewarding career where you'll be valued from day one. €33,000 - €44,000 a year Up to €44,000 DOE We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
